data.one_liner: Lightweight TextEditingController extension for user mentions, hashtags, and entity tagging.
data.what_it_does: Extends the standard TextField with a TagTextEditingController to let users mention users or insert hashtags. It parses tags into database-friendly formats and converts them into frontend display representations or InlineSpans.
use_when: You need user mentions or hashtags in a text input field.
You want database-friendly tag representation (e.g., storing IDs instead of display names).
avoid_when: You are not using standard TextField widgets.
You require complex WYSIWYG rich text editor features beyond inline mentions.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the standard TextField widget.
Handles backspacing over a tag by deleting the entire tag automatically.
Supports customizable tag styles and multiple tagging prefixes.
weaknesses: Cursor position and selection ranges around tags can have imperfect behavior.
Requires manual implementation of overlay/search UI through callbacks.
